text: The box is still on the table, and the new phone smells of plastic.
prefix: The box is still on the table, and the new phone smells of plastic.

text: Aziz moves his SIM card into it and installs the mobile bank.
prefix: Aziz moves his SIM card into it and installs the mobile bank.

text: He types his number and his password, and both are right.
prefix: He types his number and his password, and both are right.

text: Isn't that enough?
prefix: Isn't that enough?

text: A stranger with a swapped SIM card and a guessed password would have exactly the same two things.
prefix: A stranger with a swapped SIM card and a guessed password would have exactly the same two things.

text: In Lesson 23, Aziz logged in on a phone the platform already knew.
prefix: In Lesson 23, Aziz logged in on a phone the platform already knew.

text: This lesson starts on a phone it has never seen: the new-device code, the approval on the old phone, and the account check.
prefix: This lesson starts on a phone it has never seen: the new-device code, the approval on the old phone, and the account check.

text: The gateway checks the password first, as always.
prefix: The gateway checks the password first, as always.

text: Nothing starts before a correct password.
prefix: Nothing starts before a correct password.

text: Then it looks for the device identifier, and finds nothing: this phone is not known for Aziz.
prefix: Then it looks for the device identifier, and finds nothing: this phone is not known for Aziz.

text: So the gateway opens a new-device request.
prefix: So the gateway opens a new-device request.

text: In the master app, the new-device code goes out at once.
prefix: In the master app, the new-device code goes out at once.

text: TAF sends it by SMS to Aziz's verified number.
prefix: TAF sends it by SMS to Aziz's verified number.

text: The message says it is for a login, and it names the model of the new phone.
prefix: The message says it is for a login, and it names the model of the new phone.

text: The SIM card is in the new phone, so the code lands there.
prefix: The SIM card is in the new phone, so the code lands there.

text: That proves the SIM.
prefix: That proves the SIM.

text: It does not prove the person.
prefix: It does not prove the person.

text: Now the old phone.
prefix: Now the old phone.

text: It is still on Aziz's desk, and it still has a session in the mobile bank.
prefix: It is still on Aziz's desk, and it still has a session in the mobile bank.

text: That session passed a green verdict, so it has rank two.
prefix: That session passed a green verdict, so it has rank two.

text: Lesson 29 explains rank.
prefix: Lesson 29 explains rank.

text: For now, rank two means a session the platform trusts to answer for Aziz.
prefix: For now, rank two means a session the platform trusts to answer for Aziz.

text: The platform sends a push signal to the old phone.
prefix: The platform sends a push signal to the old phone.

text: The signal carries no code, only the number of the request.
prefix: The signal carries no code, only the number of the request.

text: The old phone then pulls the request over its own session.
prefix: The old phone then pulls the request over its own session.

text: It shows the model of the new phone, the network address, and the time.
prefix: It shows the model of the new phone, the network address, and the time.

text: It shows a warning: never give any code to another person.
prefix: It shows a warning: never give any code to another person.

text: And it shows two buttons: Approve, and This was not me.
prefix: And it shows two buttons: Approve, and This was not me.

text: I think the warning matters as much as the buttons.
prefix: I think the warning matters as much as the buttons.

text: Many thefts start with a friendly voice that asks for a code.
prefix: Many thefts start with a friendly voice that asks for a code.

text: Here, the old phone never shows a code at all, so there is nothing to read out.
prefix: Here, the old phone never shows a code at all, so there is nothing to read out.

text: Aziz taps Approve on the old phone, and types the code on the new one.
prefix: Aziz taps Approve on the old phone, and types the code on the new one.

text: With a rank-two session on a different phone, the login needs both: a correct code and the approval.
prefix: With a rank-two session on a different phone, the login needs both: a correct code and the approval.

text: If the old phone stays silent for the whole approval waiting period, a correct code is enough.
prefix: If the old phone stays silent for the whole approval waiting period, a correct code is enough.

text: If no other phone has a rank-two session, a correct code is enough from the start.
prefix: If no other phone has a rank-two session, a correct code is enough from the start.

text: A session of rank one gets only a notice, without the buttons.
prefix: A session of rank one gets only a notice, without the buttons.

text: Next comes the verdict from TAF, as in Lesson 12.
prefix: Next comes the verdict from TAF, as in Lesson 12.

text: Today it is green.
prefix: Today it is green.

text: Now the account check.
prefix: Now the account check.

text: The platform asks one question: what kind of account is this?
prefix: The platform asks one question: what kind of account is this?

text: If nobody used any of its devices for longer than the dormancy period, the account is dormant.
prefix: If nobody used any of its devices for longer than the dormancy period, the account is dormant.

text: Lesson 32 covers that.
prefix: Lesson 32 covers that.

text: If the customer was never at level two, the login completes at level one.
prefix: If the customer was never at level two, the login completes at level one.

text: When an app needs more, the customer does a step-up.
prefix: When an app needs more, the customer does a step-up.

text: Aziz was at level two, so his new phone must prove his face.
prefix: Aziz was at level two, so his new phone must prove his face.

text: The mobile bank asks for consent, then runs a MyID re-check.
prefix: The mobile bank asks for consent, then runs a MyID re-check.

text: If the reusable identifier has expired, it runs a full proofing instead.
prefix: If the reusable identifier has expired, it runs a full proofing instead.

text: His face matches.
prefix: His face matches.

text: This is the guard that a stranger cannot pass.
prefix: This is the guard that a stranger cannot pass.

text: The stranger may hold the SIM card, may know the password, and may even catch the code.
prefix: The stranger may hold the SIM card, may know the password, and may even catch the code.

text: But he does not have Aziz's face.
prefix: But he does not have Aziz's face.

text: Now the login completes.
prefix: Now the login completes.

text: The platform makes a record for the new phone.
prefix: The platform makes a record for the new phone.

text: It passed MyID on this device, so the state is Trusted.
prefix: It passed MyID on this device, so the state is Trusted.

text: Without a MyID check, it would be Known.
prefix: Without a MyID check, it would be Known.

text: Then comes a new access grant.
prefix: Then comes a new access grant.

text: Last, the notice: new device login.
prefix: Last, the notice: new device login.

text: It goes by push to Aziz's other devices, and by SMS to his number, with the model, the network address and the time.
prefix: It goes by push to Aziz's other devices, and by SMS to his number, with the model, the network address and the time.

text: The platform writes an audit event, and sends an event to the antifraud system of the bank.
prefix: The platform writes an audit event, and sends an event to the antifraud system of the bank.

text: And the other button?
prefix: And the other button?

text: If Aziz had tapped This was not me, the login would end at once, and his number would go on hold.
prefix: If Aziz had tapped This was not me, the login would end at once, and his number would go on hold.

text: Lesson 31 shows why.
prefix: Lesson 31 shows why.

text: One last note on side apps.
prefix: One last note on side apps.

text: On a new phone in the marketplace, the approval in the master app replaces the code.
prefix: On a new phone in the marketplace, the approval in the master app replaces the code.

text: With no rank-two session, the bank's SMS service sends the code, and the session starts at level one.
prefix: With no rank-two session, the bank's SMS service sends the code, and the session starts at level one.

text: Lesson 26 covers the details.
prefix: Lesson 26 covers the details.

text: To recap.
prefix: To recap.

text: On a new phone, the number and the password are not enough.
prefix: On a new phone, the number and the password are not enough.

text: The code proves the SIM card.
prefix: The code proves the SIM card.

text: The old phone approves.
prefix: The old phone approves.

text: And MyID proves the face.
prefix: And MyID proves the face.

text: Now Aziz is safe from a stranger's hands.
prefix: Now Aziz is safe from a stranger's hands.

text: But what if a stranger guides Aziz's own hands, on a phone call, and asks him to install a screen-sharing app?
prefix: But what if a stranger guides Aziz's own hands, on a phone call, and asks him to install a screen-sharing app?
